scripts.sync:production: node -e "const u=new URL(process.env.CAPACITOR_SERVER_URL||'');if(u.protocol!=='https:'||u.origin!==u.href.replace(/\/$/,''))throw Error('CAPACITOR_SERVER_URL must be an HTTPS origin with no path')" && cap sync
scripts.build:android: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),vars=['ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PATH','ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD','ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS','ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD','ANDROID_VERSION_CODE','ANDROID_VERSION_NAME'],missing=vars.filter(k=>!process.env[k]);if(missing.length)throw Error('Missing '+missing.join(', '));if(!/^\d+$/.test(process.env.ANDROID_VERSION_CODE)||Number(process.env.ANDROID_VERSION_CODE)<1)throw Error('ANDROID_VERSION_CODE must be a positive integer');if(!fs.existsSync(process.env.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PATH)||!fs.existsSync('android/app/google-services.json'))throw Error('Android keystore or google-services.json is missing')" && npm run sync:production && cd android && gradlew bundleRelease
